meta.description: Evidence list for the Space Garden Simulator: crises, symptoms and actions recorded in ISS Veggie plant growth tests, with the source sentence for each. Verdicts are assigned by the team from the cited record. Every delta is a game value set for game balance, not a NASA value.
meta.ai_disclosure: An AI coding assistant helped search the source documents and draft this file. Each quote was checked by script to be a verbatim substring of the cited source text. The team reviews verdicts and game values.

crises.name: Water shortage
crises.summary: In the VEG-01A and VEG-01B lettuce tests the plants had periods of low water early in growth.

actions.name: Add water directly to the plant pillows
actions.reason: Water added directly to the pillow reaches the roots without waiting for the reservoir.

actions.name: Refill the root mat reservoir
actions.reason: The reservoir supplies water slowly, so the roots recover only in part.

actions.name: Wait for the next scheduled watering
actions.reason: The roots keep drying until the next scheduled watering.

actions.name: Set the fan to high
actions.reason: More air flow dries the plants faster when water is already short.

source.title: Khodadad et al. (2020), Microbiological and Nutritional Analysis of Lettuce Crops Grown on the International Space Station, Frontiers in Plant Science

crises.name: Excess water and stagnant air leading to mold
crises.summary: In the VEG-01C zinnia test, excess water and a lack of air flow were followed by fungal growth on the plants.

record.note: This record is from zinnia, not lettuce. It happened in the same Veggie hardware.

symptoms.name: Water droplets at the leaf tips
Fungal growth on leaves and stems

actions.name: Set the fan to high
actions.reason: More air flow removes the moisture that builds up around the leaves.

actions.name: Cut away the dead tissue
actions.reason: Removing dead tissue leaves less material for fungus to grow on, but the air stays humid.

actions.name: Clean the plant surfaces with sanitizing wipes
actions.reason: Cleaning removes what is on the surface, but the air stays humid.

actions.name: Add more water
actions.reason: More water on plants that already have too much makes the excess worse.

steps.name: Harvest and sanitize
steps.description: Harvest the leaves on cultivation day 33 and wipe them with produce sanitizing wipes.

steps.name: Freeze and return samples
steps.description: Freeze part of the harvest and return it to Earth.

steps.name: Ground analysis report
steps.description: The returned samples are analyzed on the ground.

microbial_range.description: Total counts for bacteria and yeast/molds reported for flight and ground lettuce tissues.

source.title: Khodadad et al. (2020), Microbiological and Nutritional Analysis of Lettuce Crops Grown on the International Space Station, Frontiers in Plant Science
